## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

The Source UI counts all retained upload rows toward a fixed limit of 16. Completed/failed history can disable add, replacement and resume even when active Source capacity is available.

Found by the subsequent #456 audit at main commit dc17dead07c1d1f66e1806412cb7623812601bf1.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Accept 16 Sources, withdraw one, then add another and replace an active Source without reloading the page.
- [ ] Completed/failed rows do not permanently consume intake capacity; preserve independent failure retry and saved-candidate recovery.
- [ ] Keep server-authoritative membership limits and bounded pending UI work; add workflow and browser regressions.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

Source transactions load, scan and rewrite the entire retained candidate history; paging the response afterward does not bound persistence work.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 4.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Bound lookup, mutation and pagination work independently of historical candidate count at the real persistence boundary.
- [ ] Preserve equal replay, conflicting reuse, exact candidate status, rollback and current-policy/concurrency fencing.
- [ ] Add a growing-history regression without imposing a lifetime Author quota or discarding replay responsibility.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

A broker peer that accepts TCP but never sends NATS INFO can leave a live socket after connection timeout or runtime disposal.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 3.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Reproduce through actual User and Wallpaper adapter acquisition paths and audit equivalent new Asset worker connections.
- [ ] Close underlying transports on failed startup, cancellation and disposal; preserve successful connection/shutdown behavior.
- [ ] Verify native socket closure rather than only timing out the caller.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

Wallpaper listing lacks the request cancellation used by adjacent routes, leaving work running after client disconnect or UI abandonment.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 7.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Disconnect a real HTTP list request with a pending controlled operation and verify underlying cancellation.
- [ ] Verify bounded shutdown cleanup and retain a successful-request control.
- [ ] Keep UI navigation/session cancellation connected to the actual request lifetime.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

## Parent

[#456](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/456)

## What to build

A permitted animation can exceed the inspector's 16-KiB facts-response limit, causing deterministic worker failure while the candidate remains inspecting.

Original reproduction and review evidence: [#538](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/538), concern 9.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Exercise the recorded 1,850-frame WebP case under its supported configured picture policy through the real inspection/candidate-status path.
- [ ] Supported input reaches a correct durable outcome; internal protocol bounds agree with effective input policy and measured operational constraints.
- [ ] Preserve timing, loop, cancellation/reaping and valid controls; do not invent an Author restriction to hide the mismatch.
- [ ] Demonstrate the regression before the repair and validate the fix at the relevant test boundaries.

## Blocked by

None. Repair now; do not wait for later rendition specifications. Coordinate overlapping files with other repair tickets.

commonAudit.body:
## Repair plan

The maintainer has replaced the earlier after-all-specs deferral with repairs now, before completing #456. The eleven issues below are native children of #456; this issue preserves the original review evidence and tracks their resolution. No finding is fixed merely by being ticketed.

- [ ] [#545: Enforce the configured Clerk session-token profile](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/545)
- [ ] [#546: Keep older Wallpapers reachable for owner Source management](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/546)
- [ ] [#547: Close broker transports when connection acquisition fails](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/547)
- [ ] [#548: Bound Source transactions as candidate history grows](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/548)
- [ ] [#549: Avoid global quarantine scans during workflow reconciliation](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/549)
- [ ] [#550: Qualify controlled and production lifecycle adapters against shared contracts](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/550)
- [ ] [#551: Cancel Wallpaper list work when its request ends](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/551)
- [ ] [#552: Accept SDR JPEGs with HDR-like text in ordinary EXIF](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/552)
- [ ] [#553: Align animation inspection output limits with supported inputs](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/553)
- [ ] [#554: Release completed upload rows so Source management can continue](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/554)
- [ ] [#555: Reject changed-byte replay for rejected or cancelled candidates](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/issues/555)

Each repair can start independently; coordinate overlapping files. This index is blocked by those repair tickets, not by the remaining rendition specifications. Keep #456 open until the repairs land and final acceptance is recorded.

## Review provenance

The original reviewed comparison was `9b00ba3f6d359684e8210b740f4def1ca044b53f...c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519`. It included PRs #481, #489, #492, #504, #505, #506, #507, #508, #510, #511, #513 and #530. All nine concerns were assessed as P2. Links below pin that reviewed implementation, rather than assuming its current line numbers survive the later work.

The original review used independent Spec, Standards and Asset-correctness reviews. Fresh focused verification passed 229 existing tests, including PostgreSQL contracts and the real User/API/Asset/NATS attachment/deletion/replay round trip. Those green tests do not close the concerns below. Full CI, deployed browser E2E, production identity qualification and physical HDR acceptance were not rerun by that review.

## Original nine concerns and evidence

### 1. Enforce the selected Clerk session-token profile

The [Asset verifier](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/asset/src/adapters/authors/clerk.ts#L66-L82) and [Wallpaper verifier](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/wallpaper/src/adapters/creators/index.ts#L37-L57) accept ordinarily valid signed JWTs without the session-bound `sid` claim. Asset configuration selects `tokenProfile: 'session'`, but that selection is not enforced. Existing positive cryptographic tests generate markerless tokens and assert successful Owner/Creator authentication. [Clerk's documentation](https://clerk.com/docs/guides/sessions/jwt-templates) distinguishes custom JWTs from session-bound tokens.

- [ ] Verify and enforce the actual selected session-token profile, with a valid session-token control and rejection of an otherwise matching custom/template token. Preserve issuer/signature, expiry, applicable audience/authorized-party and exact Owner namespace/subject checks. This is not a request for an unselected online revocation scheme.

### 2. Keep older Wallpapers reachable for owner management and saved-work recovery

The [workflow list](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/wallpaper/src/adapters/workflow/index.ts#L150-L163) returns only the newest 100 records without a continuation. RecentCreations consumes that single list and supplies the sole UI entry to existing Wallpaper Source managers. After 100 newer creations, an older Wallpaper or pending creation loses its UI management/recovery entry after reload, while its authenticated API remains available. This was established by a static store-to-HTTP-to-UI trace; the proposed 101-record database reproduction was not executed.

- [ ] Cover an Owner with more than 100 creations and prove that an older published Wallpaper and an older pending creation remain reachable through the real owner UI for the applicable Source actions and recovery. Keep queries bounded and preserve owner isolation. A public catalogue entry alone does not establish pending-work recovery.

### 3. Close broker transports when acquisition fails before NATS INFO

New connections in [User](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/user/src/adapters/picture-attachments/index.ts#L35-L56), [Wallpaper](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/wallpaper/src/adapters/asset-workflow/index.ts#L35-L65), Asset command/result notification, Source confirmation and cleanup workers register their release callback only after `connect()` returns. A TCP peer that accepts a connection but never sends INFO causes a timeout while retaining a live socket after runtime disposal. This was reproduced through both actual User and Wallpaper adapter layers; the other new sites use the same acquisition pattern. Wallpaper's separate health worker already contains this SDK limitation, but does not own these workflow transports.

- [ ] Exercise actual public acquisition paths with a peer that never sends INFO. Observe native socket closure after the existing failed-startup timeout, cancellation and runtime disposal, while preserving successful connection/shutdown behavior. Do not merely bound the caller's wait.

### 4. Bound Source transaction work independently of retained candidate history

[Source persistence](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/asset/src/adapters/sources/postgres.ts#L131-L155) loads, scans and rewrites the entire candidate history. The 32-item response page is sliced after that work. A public-capability create/cancel probe retained 256 candidate records and 127,411 serialized bytes with zero pending candidates. That probe used a controlled store; the corresponding PostgreSQL access cost follows from the production implementation, not a measured latency threshold. Byte cleanup does not compact active Asset history.

- [ ] Keep lookup, mutation and pagination work bounded as candidate history grows, and qualify the actual persistence boundary. Preserve equal replay, conflicting reuse, exact candidate status and current-policy/concurrency guarantees. Do not solve this by inventing a lifetime Author quota or silently dropping replay responsibility.

### 5. Avoid global quarantine scans during entity-local attention reconciliation

[User](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/user/src/adapters/picture-attachments/attention.ts#L24-L33) and [Wallpaper](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/wallpaper/src/adapters/workflow/index.ts#L127-L137) select all unresolved quarantine payloads and decode them to find the current intent/Asset while holding entity locks. Unrelated Owners' backlogs therefore increase ordinary progress, acknowledgement and recovery work. The unrestricted queries were inspected statically; no backlog latency load test was performed.

- [ ] Reconcile only relevant durable responsibilities with bounded/indexed access. Test unrelated quarantines, independent duties, deliberate recovery and stale acknowledgements. Preserve unresolved work and notification/recovery identities rather than imposing a new silent eviction policy.

### 6. Make controlled adapters satisfy shared stateful port guarantees

[Source byte fakes](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/asset/test/sources-decisions.unit.test.ts#L100-L124) overwrite immutable identities and omit digest verification. A SourceStore fake ignores active-policy revision. [Lifecycle's fake](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/asset/test/lifecycle.unit.test.ts#L18-L35) always assigns `asset_assigned` and ignores lookup identity. Production-specific integration tests exist, but the new controlled/production pairs lack the shared qualification required by the adapter testing standards.

- [ ] Exercise the declared shared guarantees against both controlled and production implementations at their public ports, with isolated state. Include immutable replay/conflict and digest verification, keyed lookup/non-reused identity, transaction rollback and active-policy fencing where declared. Follow the then-current authoritative testing standards rather than duplicating the entire capability matrix at every boundary.

### 7. Cancel Wallpaper list work when its HTTP/UI lifetime ends

[`GET /wallpapers`](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/wallpaper/src/http/creation.ts#L129-L140) calls `runPromise` without the request signal/controller used by the neighboring creation routes. An actual HTTP disconnect probe with a controlled pending Creation operation left list work running; the equivalent get operation cancelled. RecentCreations polling can abandon requests on navigation or session changes, while authentication/database work continues outside that route's shutdown cancellation set.

- [ ] Verify client-disconnect and bounded shutdown cancellation through the real list HTTP entry, with a pending controlled operation and a successful-request control. Ensure underlying work/resources are released, not just the response.

### 8. Preserve valid SDR JPEGs whose ordinary EXIF contains HDR-like text

The [encoded-policy checker](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/asset/src/adapters/sources/encoded-policy.ts#L41-L45) searches every JPEG APP1 payload for substrings including `21496`. Two otherwise identical 483-byte SDR JPEGs with EXIF ImageDescription `Frame 21495` and `Frame 21496` respectively verified and failed as `unsupported-source-model` in the actual inspector. No HDR data is needed.

- [ ] Recognize actual container/model declarations without treating unrelated EXIF text as authority. Retain a neighboring valid SDR case and real excluded/unqualified HDR cases under the effective policy. Native HDR work in #461/#462 may already replace this guard; preserve the exact false-positive regression when checking that outcome.

### 9. Align animation inspection results with permitted input and durable outcomes

The [storage adapter](https://github.com/rafaeltab/wallpaperdb/blob/c35e8d6410170bfa6257b27752955b7bf41e4519/apps/asset/src/adapters/sources/storage.ts#L223-L243) kills the inspector above 16,384 output bytes, while the worker emits one timing per frame. A valid 92,544-byte, 1,850-frame WebP with 10,000,000 ms frame delays under a supported configured `squareSize: 1` picture policy produced 16,902 bytes of verified facts in the unmodified worker. The actual production adapter killed that worker and returned SourceFailure. This is a supported configuration reproduction, not qualification of default 512-square processing capacity. The capability had already persisted `inspecting`, so same-byte replay repeats the deterministic failure until cancellation/expiry.

- [ ] Test permitted animation/frame/timing boundaries through the real inspection and candidate-status path. A supported input must reach a valid durable outcome; internal protocol limits must agree with effective policy and measured operational profiles. Preserve timing, loop and ordinary valid controls. #457's measured inspection/frame/output work and #460/#461 may already address this concern; a shared limiter alone is not proof that the response mismatch was fixed. Do not invent a new Author restriction merely to hide the reproduction.


## Additional audit findings

10. Historical Source upload rows permanently consume the UI's 16-row allowance. After 16 successful uploads and a withdrawal, add/replacement remains blocked until reload. Failed history also consumes the allowance. Track repair and workflow/browser regression in #554.

11. Rejected/cancelled candidate uploads return before comparing an existing byte digest. Replaying different bytes returns the old result instead of the promised conflict. Track terminal-state capability/HTTP regressions in #555.

## Completion and limits

- [ ] Account for every concern with a current reproduction and landed repair, or exact prior landed evidence plus a behavioral regression proving it is already resolved or no longer applicable.
- [ ] Run the required current checks and fresh affected Standards/Spec reviews for the final repairs. Record actual tested/reviewed comparisons and remaining limits.
- [ ] Keep the issue open until the remaining changes reach the default branch and all eleven repair dispositions are evidenced. Do not report the prior deferral as a fix or a passed acceptance gate.

Existing release/spec acceptance requirements remain their own gates. This issue does not add dependencies from earlier specifications back to itself or redefine their required results.

The original review also noted optional duplication between User and Wallpaper durable telemetry helpers. Reconsider it only if those technical helpers remain identical; it is a P3 judgment call and not a tenth required P2 fix. Keep context-specific workflows separate where their semantics differ.

The V8 coverage-provider patch in #530 is supporting tooling context, not another proven product defect. Its ten focused regressions passed in the review. Preserve valid subprocess coverage and existing thresholds while checking the test-contract concerns; no upstreaming or provider-replacement project is added here.

animationObserved.policy: supported squareSize=1; not a default 512-square capacity result

carryForward.dependencyAssessment: Inspected lockfile delta removes only the Vitest coverage patch and its references; runtime dependencies of these adapters are unchanged. This carries the recorded audit reproductions to the application base; it is not a fresh execution of all four regressions. #554 was reported directly at this same dc17dead base.
